scatter_tensors_to_gpus: scatter a PyTorch tensor across multiple target GPUs for data parallel training
scatter_datacontainer_to_gpus: scatter a DataContainer object to target GPUs respecting the cpu_only flag
scatter_kwargs_to_gpus: scatter both positional inputs and kwargs dictionaries across target GPUs for parallel execution
scatter_nested_structures: scatter nested tuples, lists, or dicts containing tensors to multiple GPUs recursively
scatter_cpu_inference: scatter inputs to CPU using the self-implemented Scatter forward method for CPU inference
